name: Call Agent
description: Talk to your workspace agent out loud. Open the Call window, hit call, and speak — your voice is transcribed, sent to the agent you picked, and the reply is streamed back and spoken to you in your own language. Keeps the conversation going across calls instead of starting from scratch every time.

skills.description: How the Call Agent app turns a voice call into an Agents Platform run — the WS protocol, the TTS endpoint, session continuity, and what to check when a call stalls.

auto_start.title: Auto-start PBX
auto_start.description: Start the Call Agent and its built-in Asterisk automatically with the workspace.

agent_slug.description: Agents Platform agent slug a call is routed to. Pick one that answers in short spoken prose — a coding agent will narrate tool calls at you.

external_id.description: Stable conversation key. The Target this app runs against is "<agent_slug>-<external_id>", auto-created on first call, so every call resumes the same conversation.

prompt_template.default:
CONTEXT:
- source: streaming_call
- surface: voice
Answer in short spoken prose — no markdown, no lists, no step narration. Reply in the language the user spoke.
USER_MESSAGE:
${text}
prompt_template.description: Prompt sent to the agent. ${text} is replaced by what the caller said. Put a skill slash-command on the first line (e.g. "/aw-agent-telegram") if the agent expects one.

default_voice_lang.description: Voice language used when the caller's browser does not report one (pt, en, es, it, fr, de).

agents_platform_base.description: Base URL of the Agents Platform instance. Required for SIP calls because the Tier-2 container cannot read another app's private config.

agents_platform_token.description: Identity JWT sent as Authorization: Bearer to agents_platform_base. Required for SIP calls.

poll_interval_seconds.description: How often the run's event log is polled while the agent is answering. Also the heartbeat rate the caller's stall watchdog sees.

max_poll_seconds.description: How long a single call turn may take before it is given up on.

speech_pause_ms.description: How long a pause has to be before the caller is treated as having finished speaking, in milliseconds. Raise it if you think between sentences and the call keeps cutting you off.

stt_model.title: Server speech model
stt_model.description: faster-whisper model used for SIP calls. 'base' is the low-cost default; use 'small' for better Portuguese on a stronger host.

stt_provider.title: Speech-to-text provider
stt_provider.description: Use local faster-whisper or the OpenAI transcription API. Edge is not an STT provider.

stt_openai_model.title: OpenAI STT model
stt_openai_model.description: Model sent to /v1/audio/transcriptions when OpenAI STT is selected.

tts_provider.title: Text-to-speech provider
tts_provider.description: Use Microsoft Edge TTS or the OpenAI speech API.

tts_openai_model.title: OpenAI TTS model
tts_openai_model.description: Model sent to /v1/audio/speech when OpenAI TTS is selected.

tts_openai_voice.title: OpenAI TTS voice
tts_openai_voice.description: Voice used by OpenAI TTS, for example alloy.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: Required when either STT or TTS provider is OpenAI. Stored as an app secret.

internal_sip_extension.title: Softphone extension
internal_sip_extension.description: Ramal PJSIP usado pelo Linphone para o teste interno.

internal_sip_password.title: Softphone password
internal_sip_password.description: Senha forte gerada automaticamente para o ramal interno.

call_agent_extension.title: Call Agent extension
call_agent_extension.description: Ramal que o softphone disca para falar com o Call Agent.

sip_external_address.title: Public SIP address
sip_external_address.description: Use 'auto' to resolve this workspace's public Call Agent hostname, or enter the public IP/domain advertised by Asterisk in SIP and RTP.

telephony_enabled.title: Enable SIP telephony
telephony_enabled.description: Keep disabled until the SIP account, Portuguese number and Asterisk AMI secret are configured.

sip_public_number.title: Portuguese public number
sip_public_number.description: The assigned number in E.164 form, for example +351300000000.

sip_caller_id.title: Outbound caller ID
sip_caller_id.description: Leave blank to use the public number. The provider must authorize this caller ID.

asterisk_ami_secret.title: Asterisk AMI secret
asterisk_ami_secret.description: A strong local secret used by this app to control Asterisk.

apps.reason: Holds the agents-platform base URL and identity token this app falls back to when its own are blank, and runs the agent CLI a call is dispatched to.
